title: Igicibwa mu busitani
intro: Ikiremwa cy’amayobera cyahoze gituwe mu nzego zo hejuru z’ibiremwa, cyegereye Imana kurusha uko benshi bashoboraga kubyumva. Nyamara ubwibone bwarashinze imizi, kandi igikorwa kimwe cyo kwigomeka cyahinduye inzira y’ubuzima. Noneho, iki kiremwa kiragenda nk’umwanzi w’indahiro, giterana amagambo menshi kandi gicura imigambi kugeza umunsi wasezeranijwe ugeze. Ese ushobora kumenya uwo uyu waguye ari we?
clues: Nari mu bantu bari hafi cyane y’Imana, bashyizwe hejuru y’ibindi byose byaremwe.
Naremwe mu kintu gishyuha, ntabwo naremwe mu butaka cyangwa mu ibumba.
Igihe nategekwaga kunamira ikiremwa gishya, naranze — bitewe n'icyo nizeraga ko ari cyo cyari ikirenga cyanjye.
Narajugunywe ndavumwa, ariko amaherezo nemererwa gusubikwa kugeza igihe kizwi kandi cyagenwe.
Narahiye kuyobya abantu bose uko nshoboye, negera urubyaro rwa Adamu mu mpande zose.
Ndi umwanzi w’abantu bose, uhora ategura imigambi no kuvugana kugeza ku iherezo ryagenwe.

trial.label: Urubanza / Igikorwa
options: Kubaka inyana ya zahabu abantu basenga
Yikoreye intebe y'Umwamikazi w'i Sheba mu kanya gato

outcome.label: Ibisubizo
options: Agahenge gatanzwe kugeza ku munsi w'urubanza
Yarohamye mu nyanja ari kumwe n'ingabo
Yashyinguwe ari muzima munsi y'ingoro yari irimo gusenyuka
outcome.answer: Agahenge gatanzwe kugeza ku munsi w'urubanza

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَغْوَيْتَنِى لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verse: [Iblees] said, "My Lord, because You have put me in error, I will surely make [disobedience] attractive to them [i.e., mankind] on earth, and I will mislead them all (15:39)
